name: pi-cmux-presence
description: Socket-only cmux presence observer for Pi

scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run test
scripts.diagram:render: set -e; for src in docs/diagram/*.mmd; do stem="${src%.mmd}"; bunx @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -p docs/diagram/puppeteer-config.json -c docs/diagram/mermaid-config.json -i "$src" -o "$stem.svg" -b white; bunx @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -p docs/diagram/puppeteer-config.json -c docs/diagram/mermaid-config.json -i "$src" -o "$stem.png" -b white -s 2; done
